page: Microsoft Azure D4s_v3 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DSv3 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2673 v4 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The virtual machine includes 33 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage configurations, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the D4s_v3 is positioned in the lower tiers for compute-heavy tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show weak to poor performance, with read-only small block cached bandwidth in the bottom 10% and large block uncached read and write operations in the bottom 25%. However, the Passmark memory score achieves an average rating, landing in the middle 50% of benchmarks.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the D4s_v3 is suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate resource demands. It is appropriate for light web serving, basic database operations, and development or testing environments. The instance exhibits a clear tradeoff, offering dedicated CPU allocation and Premium Storage capability at a lower performance tier, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require high-throughput memory or intensive computational processing.
